name: Tooltip Wp
author: Themepoints

sections.description:
Pure CSS3 Tooltips For WordPress is a lightweight, easy to use tooltips plugin for WordPress. It’s based on pure CSS3 and comes with some different style, different tooltip positions, optional tooltip headers, support for images.

  • How to use? !»

Plugin Features

  • 5 Beautiful Style.
  • Pure CSS3.
  • CSS3 animation.
  • Custom Width.
  • Custom Height.
  • Lightweight Responsive.
  • Easy Option Panel.
  • Easy Documentation.

How to use?

<div class="tooltips" data-tipso="This is a top Tooltip!">Top</div>
sections.installation:
1. Install as regular WordPress plugin.
  2. Go your Pluings setting via WordPress Dashboard and activate it.
  3. After activate plugin you will see “Tool Tip” menu at left side on WordPress dashboard and find “Tooltip Option settings”

How to use?

<span class="tooltips" data-tipso="This is a top Tooltip!">Top</span>
